_comment: YouTube (and other video-host) destination channels for Phase 6 uploads. This file holds STRUCTURE ONLY — never secrets. `credentials_ref` names the env-var PREFIX whose *_CLIENT_ID / *_CLIENT_SECRET / *_REFRESH_TOKEN (documented in .env.example) hold the actual OAuth credentials, resolved at upload time by net/publish.py only when VIDTRANS_PUBLISH_ENABLED=1. A per-project override may live in project.yaml.distribution.youtube.channelId. `framework validate` rejects two default:true channels for the same language.
